name: Cape Verde Swift
rangeDescription: Cape verde islands
description: Small endemic swift of Cape Verde. Smaller and more gray-brown compared to other swifts, with prominent whitish throat patch.

name: Rufous-webbed Brilliant
rangeDescription: Andean foothills of eastern peru and (?) northwestern bolivia
description: Large, green hummingbird of montane forest. Males have a small red throat patch; females are duller green with a white-speckled belly.

name: White-tailed Swallow
rangeDescription: Arid highlands of southern ethiopia (sidamo province)
description: A small swallow with white underparts and dark blue upperparts. The tail shows an unusual pattern: a dark rim around large white panels both above and below.

name: Seychelles Fody
rangeDescription: Seychelles islands (cousin, cousine, and frégate)
description: An unusual drab, long-billed fody. Breeding males have yellow patches on the face.

name: Stejneger's Petrel
rangeDescription: Alejandro selkirk island (off chile); ranges eastern and north pacific
description: Medium-sized, elegant seabird of the deep Pacific Ocean, rare in Japanese waters. Grayish above, white below, with dark “M” pattern in upperparts.

name: Spur-winged Lapwing
rangeDescription: Senegambia to red sea, northeastern tanzania, and eastern mediterranean
description: This medium-large plover is often locally abundant, noisy, and easy to identify. Its plumage is a striking combination of black, white, and brown.

name: Pearly-breasted Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Locally from northern south america to southern brazil and northeastern argentina
description: Brownish above and white below with a black upper bill and yellow lower bill. The tail is long and graduated with black centers and white tips as seen from below.

name: Lovely Sunbird
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (balabac, busuanga, culion, and palawan)
description: A tiny bird of wooded areas from the lowlands to the mountains of Palawan and neighboring islands. Has a fairly long, curved bill, a whitish belly, and olive wings.

name: Crescent-faced Antpitta
rangeDescription: Locally in andes of southern colombia and ecuador
description: Small, striking antpitta that lurks in bamboo-laden cloud forest at very high elevations in the Andes. Brown and gray with white crescents on face, streaked underparts, and buffy spots on sides of neck.

name: Lesser Adjutant
rangeDescription: India and sri lanka to southern china, indochina, and indonesia
description: A large stork with a completely bare head and neck ideal for its scavenging habits. The adult’s face is red and the neck is yellow while the juvenile has a brownish head and a white, thinly-feathered neck.

name: Gray-legged Tinamou
rangeDescription: Tropical forest of east-central colombia to southern venezuela
description: Unobtrusive, poorly-known tinamou. Mostly rusty-colored with a scaly back and wings.

name: Cerulean Warbler
rangeDescription: Eastern north america; winters mountains of colombia to venezuela and southward in andes to western bolivia
description: Brilliant sky-blue warbler of the high canopy. Prefers mature deciduous forest, either in riparian areas or dry mountain ridge-tops.

name: Whitehead
rangeDescription: North island, and little and great barrier, arid, and kapiti islands (new zealand)
description: A small endemic songbird found only on the North Island of New Zealand. Note distinctive whitish head and underparts.

name: Brazilian Merganser
rangeDescription: South-central south america (paraguai-paraná drainage system)
description: Unmistakable in range. Odd-looking duck with a long thin bill, dark green head, and spiky crest.

name: Southern Chestnut-breasted Wren
rangeDescription: Tropical and subtropical east slope of andes of peru south and east of the maranon river (amazonas south to puno) and western bolivia (la paz)
description: Found at higher elevations than other members of its genus. Shy and uncommon denizen of forest undergrowth from 1,100–2,000 m.

name: Pale-headed Jacamar
rangeDescription: Tropical northeastern colombia and northwestern venezuela
description: Small jacamar with a pale brown head and bluish-black wings and tail. Smaller than other jacamars in range, with a shorter tail.

name: Pink-browed Rosefinch
rangeDescription: Himalayan fir and birch forest from kashmir to southern tibet
description: Graceful medium-sized rosefinch of the Himalayas. Male is bright raspberry pink with a clean “browed” facial pattern and faint streaking on the back.

name: Lesser Whistling-Duck
rangeDescription: Indian subcontinent to southeastern asia and greater sundas
description: A small, well-proportioned, tree-nesting duck. Pale brown overall with a darker brown crown and nape, warmer chestnut underparts, and chestnut-fringed feathers on the back.

name: Javan Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Mountains of java
description: Typical scops-owl, endemic to Java’s montane and foothill forests. Favors the upper and middle levels of the forest, frequently roosting and foraging in the lower canopy.

name: Waigeo Brushturkey
rangeDescription: Waigeo (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A very little-known, large, black ground bird endemic to the upland forests on Waigeo Island. Black above with some chestnut in the breast and a bare pink head and throat.
